mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous three months signals strong consumer demand, which drives corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combined effect of high interest rates and inflationary pressure leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the previous month signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous two months signals a weakening in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is also declining, the combined effect signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO is declining.
